description:
Marble is a private workout journal for fast logging, focused training, and clear progress. No account, ads, or third-party tracking.

WRITE IT YOUR WAY
Type or paste a workout in gym notation, bring in multi-day notes, or import a Hevy or Strong CSV. Scan handwritten workouts with on-device text recognition. When available, Apple Intelligence helps structure workout text on your device.

Review exercises, sets, weights, reps, distances, dates, rest, and notes before saving. Lines Marble can't organize stay in review until you fix them or keep them in your workout notes. Weights without a unit follow your kg or lb preference. Save an unfinished review and return to it later. Log the same typed workout on another day while keeping same-day duplicate protection.

KEEP YOUR TRAINING MOVING
- Log weights, reps, distance, time, RPE, rest, and notes
- Repeat your last set or use Save + Next
- Start and finish workout sessions
- Search Workout History by workout or exercise and review a session before repeating it
- Build weekly splits and reusable sprint prescriptions
- Follow rest timers with a Live Activity and rest-complete alerts

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Track personal records, estimated one-rep max, weekly goals, and consistency
- See your Top Exercises and the dates of your best lifts
- Review Monthly Reports and Daily Highlights
- Explore muscle-group, rep-range, effort, supplement, and calendar views
- Record bodyweight or import it from Apple Health
- Compare a lift's estimated strength relative to bodyweight
- Browse attributed training quotes that fit your text size

CONNECT WITH iOS
Add a Weekly Goal widget, find exercises in Spotlight, and use Siri or Shortcuts to log sets and manage workout sessions. Open quick logging from supported Control Center, Lock Screen, or Action button controls.

OPTIONAL APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Import Apple Health workouts, including workouts recorded by Apple Watch and Garmin apps that write to Health. Optionally export completed strength sessions to Apple Health. Health access is permission-based; you can use Marble without it.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR DATA
Your core training data is stored locally on your iPhone or iPad. Export and restore a portable JSON backup. Progress photos and videos stay on your device and are not included in those backup files. Marble has no account system or Marble-operated server.

Apple Intelligence features require a compatible device, supported language, and Apple Intelligence availability. Workout notation and structured file imports can be reviewed without Apple Intelligence.
promotionalText: Add workouts in your own words. Marble 2.7 keeps count-only drills, every sprint effort, and your exercise order the way you wrote them.
whatsNew:
Marble 2.7 keeps more of what you actually wrote when you add a workout.

- Count-only drills like "Bounds (2 sets)" keep every set, without invented reps or weight.
- Distance work like "Sprints, 2 sets, 50m each" keeps each effort and its distance.
- Better reading of everyday notes, circuits, set ladders, and light kg loads.
- Review shows workout totals and lets you check your original text.
- Lines Marble can't organize stay in review until you fix them or keep them in workout notes, so nothing is dropped silently.
- Workout History and Repeat keep exercises and sets in the order you wrote them.
- Apple Intelligence readings are checked against your note: dates, titles, and numbers must come from what you wrote.
- Top Exercises in Progress always covers your whole history, with each exercise's all-time best set.
- VoiceOver announces sets recorded without numbers.
